[package]
name = "clack-common"
version = "0.2.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.85.0"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/prokopyl/clack"
description = "Various utilities for working with the CLAP audio plugin API, for both plugins and hosts."
categories = ["api-bindings", "multimedia::audio"]
keywords = ["clap", "audio", "plugin", "host", "bindings"]
authors = ["Adrien Prokopowicz <prokopylmc@gmail.com>"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]

[dependencies]
clap-sys = "0.5.0"
bitflags = "2.11.0"

[dev-dependencies]
static_assertions = "1.1.0"

[lints.rust]
unsafe-op-in-unsafe-fn = "allow"
missing-docs = "deny"

[lints.clippy]
undocumented-unsafe-blocks = "deny"
cast-possible-truncation = "deny"
cast-possible-wrap = "deny"
cast-precision-loss = "deny"
cast-ptr-alignment = "deny"
cast-sign-loss = "deny"
checked-conversions = "warn"
invalid_upcast_comparisons = "deny"
transmute_ptr_to_ptr = "deny"

[package]
name = "clack-extensions"
version = "0.2.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.85.0"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/prokopyl/clack"
description = "A collection of wrappers and utilities for all the standard CLAP extensions, for use with the clack-plugin or clack-host crates."
categories = ["api-bindings", "multimedia::audio"]
keywords = ["clap", "audio", "plugin", "host", "bindings"]
authors = ["Adrien Prokopowicz <prokopylmc@gmail.com>"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]

[dependencies]
clap-sys = "0.5.0"
bitflags = "2.11.0"

[dependencies.clack-plugin]
optional = true
path = "./plugin"
version = "0.2.0"

[dependencies.clack-host]
optional = true
default-features = false
path = "./host"
version = "0.2.0"

[dependencies.clack-common]
path = "./common"
version = "0.2.0"

[dependencies.raw-window-handle_05]
optional = true
package = "raw-window-handle"
version = "0.5.2"

[dependencies.raw-window-handle_06]
optional = true
package = "raw-window-handle"
version = "0.6.0"

[dev-dependencies]
static_assertions = "1.1.0"

[dev-dependencies.clack-host]
features = ["clack-plugin"]
path = "./host"
version = "0.2.0"
default-features = false

[features]
all-extensions = ["ambisonic", "audio-ports", "audio-ports-activation", "audio-ports-config", "clap-wrapper", "configurable-audio-ports", "context-menu", "event-registry", "gui", "latency", "log", "note-name", "note-ports", "params", "param-indication", "posix-fd", "preset-discovery", "remote-controls", "render", "state", "state-context", "surround", "tail", "thread-check", "thread-pool", "timer", "track-info", "voice-info"]
ambisonic = ["audio-ports"]
audio-ports = []
audio-ports-activation = []
audio-ports-config = ["audio-ports"]
context-menu = []
clap-wrapper = []
configurable-audio-ports = ["audio-ports"]
event-registry = []
gui = []
latency = []
log = []
note-name = []
note-ports = []
params = []
param-indication = []
posix-fd = []
preset-discovery = []
remote-controls = []
render = []
state = []
state-context = ["state"]
surround = ["audio-ports"]
tail = []
thread-check = []
thread-pool = []
timer = []
track-info = ["audio-ports"]
voice-info = []

[lints.rust]
unsafe-op-in-unsafe-fn = "allow"
missing-docs = "deny"

[lints.clippy]
undocumented-unsafe-blocks = "deny"
cast-possible-truncation = "deny"
cast-possible-wrap = "deny"
cast-precision-loss = "deny"
cast-ptr-alignment = "deny"
cast-sign-loss = "deny"
checked-conversions = "warn"
invalid_upcast_comparisons = "deny"
transmute_ptr_to_ptr = "deny"

[package]
name = "clack-host"
version = "0.2.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.85.0"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/prokopyl/clack"
description = "Low-level, safe Rust wrappers to create audio plugin hosts using the CLAP audio plugin API."
categories = ["api-bindings", "multimedia::audio"]
keywords = ["clap", "audio", "plugin", "host", "bindings"]
authors = ["Adrien Prokopowicz <prokopylmc@gmail.com>"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]

[dependencies]
clap-sys = "0.5.0"

[dependencies.clack-common]
path = "./common"
version = "0.2.0"

[dependencies.clack-plugin]
optional = true
path = "./plugin"
version = "0.2.0"

[dependencies.libloading]
optional = true
version = "=0.8"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-foundation]
version = "0.3.2"
features = ["NSBundle", "NSURL"]
optional = true

[features]
default = ["libloading"]
libloading = ["dep:libloading", "dep:objc2-foundation"]
clack-plugin = ["dep:clack-plugin"]

[dev-dependencies]
static_assertions = "1.1.0"

[dev-dependencies.clack-plugin]
path = "./plugin"
version = "0.2.0"

[dev-dependencies.clack-extensions]
path = "../extensions"
features = ["clack-host", "clack-plugin", "latency", "log", "state", "timer"]

[lints.rust]
unsafe-op-in-unsafe-fn = "allow"
missing-docs = "deny"

[lints.clippy]
undocumented-unsafe-blocks = "deny"
cast-possible-truncation = "deny"
cast-possible-wrap = "deny"
cast-precision-loss = "deny"
cast-ptr-alignment = "deny"
cast-sign-loss = "deny"
checked-conversions = "warn"
invalid_upcast_comparisons = "deny"
transmute_ptr_to_ptr = "deny"

[workspace]
members = [".", "examples/browser"]

[package]
name = "midir"
version = "0.11.3"
authors = ["Patrick Reisert"]
description = "A cross-platform, realtime MIDI processing library, inspired by RtMidi."
repository = "https://github.com/Boddlnagg/midir"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = ["midi", "audio", "music", "sound"]
categories = ["multimedia::audio", "api-bindings"]
license = "MIT"
edition = "2021"

[features]
default = []
avoid_timestamping = []
coremidi_send_timestamped = []
jack = ["jack-sys", "libc", "bitflags"]
winrt = ["windows/Foundation", "windows/Foundation_Collections", "windows/Devices_Midi", "windows/Devices_Enumeration", "windows/Storage_Streams", "windows/Win32_System_WinRT"]

[dependencies]
log = "0.4"

[dependencies.bitflags]
version = "2"
optional = true

[dependencies.jack-sys]
version = "0.5"
optional = true

[dependencies.libc]
version = "0.2.21"
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies]
alsa = ">=0.11.0"
libc = "0.2.21"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"ios\")".dependencies]
coremidi = "0.9.0"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
coremidi = "0.9.0"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies.windows]
version = ">=0.59.0,<=0.62"
features = ["Win32_Foundation", "Win32_Media", "Win32_Media_Multimedia", "Win32_Media_Audio"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies.parking_lot]
version = "0.12.1"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies]
js-sys = "0.3"
wasm-bindgen = "0.2"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.web-sys]
version = "0.3"
features = ["Event", "Navigator", "Window", "MidiAccess", "MidiInput", "MidiInputMap", "MidiMessageEvent", "MidiOptions", "MidiOutput", "MidiOutputMap", "MidiPort", "MidiPortType"]

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dev-dependencies]
wasm-bindgen-test = "0.3"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies]
ndk-context = "0.1"
jni-min-helper = "0.3"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies.jni]
version = "0.21"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".build-dependencies]
cc = "1.0"

[dev-dependencies]
env_logger = "0.11"

[package]
name = "midly"
version = "0.5.3"
edition = "2024"
authors = ["negamartin"]
include = ["/src/*", "/Cargo.toml"]
description = "Fast MIDI decoder and encoder both for .mid files and real-time MIDI events"
repository = "https://github.com/negamartin/midly"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = ["midi", "no_std", "audio", "parser"]
categories = ["multimedia::audio", "multimedia::encoding", "multimedia"]
license = "Unlicense"

[features]
default = ["alloc", "std", "parallel", "serde"]
strict = []
serde = ["dep:serde", "dep:serde_bytes"]
alloc = []
std = ["alloc"]
parallel = ["std", "rayon"]

[dependencies.rayon]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
default-features = false
features = ["derive"]
optional = true

[dependencies.serde_bytes]
version = "0.11"
optional = true

[dev-dependencies]
serde_json = "1"

[package]
name = "opfs"
version = "0.2.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.85"
repository = "https://github.com/anchpop/opfs.git"
license = "MIT"
authors = ["Andre Popovitch <andre@popovit.ch>"]
description = "A Rust implementation of the Origin Private File System browser API."

[features]
unstable_apis = []

[dependencies]
futures = "0.3"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies]
wasm-bindgen = "0.2"
js-sys = "0.3"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.wasm-bindgen-futures]
version = "0.4"
features = ["futures-core-03-stream"]

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.web-sys]
version = "0.3"
features = ["File", "Blob", "Navigator", "Storage", "StorageManager", "Window", "FileSystemDirectoryHandle", "FileSystemFileHandle", "FileSystemWritableFileStream", "FileSystemGetFileOptions", "FileSystemCreateWritableOptions", "FileSystemGetDirectoryOptions", "FileSystemRemoveOptions", "WriteParams", "WriteCommandType", "FileSystemSyncAccessHandle", "FileSystemSyncAccessHandleOptions", "FileSystemReadWriteOptions"]

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies]
dirs = "6"
tempfile = "3.27"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.52"
features = ["fs", "io-util", "sync", "macros", "rt", "rt-multi-thread"]

[dev-dependencies]
wasm-bindgen-test = "0.3"

[package]
name = "wasm-bindgen-rayon"
version = "1.4.0"
authors = ["Ingvar Stepanyan <me@rreverser.com>"]
edition = "2024"
license = "Apache-2.0"
description = "Adapter for using Rayon-based concurrency on the Web"
keywords = ["web", "thread", "parallel", "concurrency", "webassembly"]
categories = ["concurrency", "wasm", "web-programming"]
readme = "README.md"
exclude = [".github"]
repository = "https://github.com/RReverser/wasm-bindgen-rayon"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["nightly"]
targets = ["wasm32-unknown-unknown"]
rustc-args = ["-C", "target-feature=+atomics,+bulk-memory", "-C", "link-arg=--shared-memory", "-C", "link-arg=--max-memory=1073741824", "-C", "link-arg=--import-memory", "-C", "link-arg=--export=__wasm_init_tls", "-C", "link-arg=--export=__tls_size", "-C", "link-arg=--export=__tls_align", "-C", "link-arg=--export=__tls_base"]

[workspace]
exclude = ["demo"]

[workspace.dependencies]
wasm-bindgen = "0.2.126"

[workspace.dependencies.rayon]
version = "1.12"
features = ["web_spin_lock"]

[dependencies]
wasm-bindgen = "0.2.126"
atomic-waker = "1"
js-sys = "0.3"
wasm-bindgen-futures = "0.4"
web-workers = "0.3"

[dependencies.rayon]
version = "1.12"
features = ["web_spin_lock"]

[dependencies.web-sys]
version = "0.3"
features = ["Window"]

[features]
nightly = []
no-bundler = []

[package]
name = "waw"
version = "0.2.0"
edition = "2021"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
targets = ["wasm32-unknown-unknown"]

[target."cfg(all(target_family = \"wasm\", target_os = \"unknown\"))".dependencies]
js-sys = "0.3.103"
wasm-bindgen-futures = "0.4.76"

[target."cfg(all(target_family = \"wasm\", target_os = \"unknown\"))".dependencies.wasm-bindgen]
version = "0.2.126"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(all(target_family = \"wasm\", target_os = \"unknown\"))".dependencies.web-workers]
version = "0.3"
features = ["audio-worklet"]

[dependencies]
inventory = "0.3.24"

[dependencies.web-sys]
version = "0.3.103"
features = ["AudioContext", "AudioWorkletNode", "AudioWorkletNodeOptions", "AudioDestinationNode", "AudioWorkletProcessor", "AudioWorklet", "AudioWorkletGlobalScope", "console"]

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/prokopyl/clack"]
git = "https://github.com/prokopyl/clack"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
branch = "main"

[source."https://github.com/mlm-games/midir"]
git = "https://github.com/mlm-games/midir"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/mlm-games/midly"]
git = "https://github.com/mlm-games/midly"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/mlm-games/opfs"]
git = "https://github.com/mlm-games/opfs"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/mlm-games/wasm-bindgen-rayon"]
git = "https://github.com/mlm-games/wasm-bindgen-rayon"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/mlm-games/waw-rs"]
git = "https://github.com/mlm-games/waw-rs"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
